signing: Development signing on the target: the installer creates a self-signed code-signing certificate, trusts it on that machine, signs the files and catalog with the WDK signtool and Inf2Cat, and requires test signing to be enabled. No production signature is claimed.
scope: Native Windows WDDM display adapter with a driver-local Vulkan loader, Venus ICD and Direct3D 10/11 UMD. The native D3D12 DLL is registered in the DX12 loader slot and negotiates R0; full feature-level support and public D3D12 device acceptance remain unfinished.
singleDisplayHandoff: Keep firmware BASICDISPLAY enabled through driver updates. Detach only its desktop path after healthy Lightning activation; never persistently disable the fallback device.
startupRepair: Keep the firmware fallback available during installation. WDDM 2.2 publishes the CPU-visible local segment and a cache-coherent system-memory aperture. Scanout primaries use local memory; CPU-lockable images use the aperture.
